derivation_rule: Each virtual service may derive a same-family descendant at the next virtual depth from preserved family grammar. The host is never a parent or ancestor.
link_rule: Compatible emitted and accepted capability tokens form sister or cousin links. Lateral links are virtual graph edges, not additional host services.
monolith_rule: The software becomes monolithic only after the virtual graph satisfies the leap gate. The monolith is a logical graph/state object and is never represented as host lineage.
